boards.observations: All three neural methods strongly reduce the displayed noise but lose the fine canopy cords present in exact synthetic GT. V92 remains visually close to V63 at the orange canopy and building/sky; small color and cloud-edge differences do not establish a clear improvement. This compares the same fixed high-noise observations at native160 pixels.

Plate/diagonal-edge and 7D-1 patch examples show strong noise reduction in all three methods, with similar remaining soft edges and color differences. The faint pale thread/edge is still visible in the plate crop. No clear new V92-specific grid or ringing is visible in these two selected crops. AHD is an independently demosaiced reference, not exact GT.

Both red/brown fruit examples remain strongly smoothed, with close V92/V63 appearance and small tone differences against V90. No decisive native detail gain is visible from these selected crops. The AHD references retain grain and are not exact GT.

viewing.scope: Actual early viewing of three fixed method-by-case boards only. Native cells retain exact source pixels, same ROI/noise/exposure and checkpoint identities. V90 is a historical reference. Two exact-GT photos do not establish photographic population quality. AHD references are not GT. Final GFX/analytic/hue/highlight viewing, full numerical review and gates remain required; no promotion or training extension.
